name: Plant Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Research doctorate in the School of Biological Sciences at the University of Oklahoma Norman campus.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall program application
publishedDeadlines.note: Applications a few weeks late may be considered; no stated entry year.

applicationFee.note: International fee $100; US citizen/permanent resident $50. Graduate College offers no general waivers; academic units may offer fee coverage, but no SBS-specific offer verified. Current OU graduate/accelerated students use a separate fee-free add/change program process; confirm category and international eligibility. International page still says waivers currently unavailable, so do not assume a general international waiver.

english.toefl: 79 legacy with each subscore 20; 4.5 new scale with each subscore 4.0
english.note: IELTS Academic every band 6.0; DET each reading/listening/speaking/writing 115. PTE 60/each 55 also listed. No MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake; single sitting. Degree from US/listed country or 24 US credits are alternative routes. Country exemption requires citizenship and education in listed country. No generic foreign MOI exemption. Scores must remain under two years at term start; teaching certification separate.

documents: Official copies of transcripts (unofficial upload for review, official after admission)
English test evidence for international applicants unless exempt
requirements.note: Department strongly encourages prospective faculty consultation. No single admission model directly established. GRE policy not stated in opened current SBS application instructions; confirm with program.

funding.note: SBS offers assistantships and additional incoming fellowships. Central international admissions explicitly says graduate-program assistantships may be available; confirm availability with academic unit. No guaranteed support, current stipend or duration verified.
